svg.title: Two data owners train with approved confidential clients
svg.desc: A worked architecture example, not a supplied or fully tested deployment. Model owner M supplies reviewed code and a model to a trusted provisioning node, which builds, signs and encrypts distinct client releases with site-1 and site-2 startup kits. Shared independent Trustee and registry administration is a jointly trusted delegate with recorded approval from both data owners. CoCo IT A and B receive only their Pod and public runtime inputs and operate hostile compute around an approved SNP plus GPU confidential client. Each data owner controls a separate authenticated dataset gateway and storage outside CoCo IT control. Dashed amber paths are required user-supplied integrations: after application-specific client authorization, each gateway sends its dataset over TLS directly into its confidential guest, without host mounts. Clients exchange model updates with M's ordinary trusted FL server over mutual TLS. Approved outputs can disclose information. Dataset integration, authorization and persistence require implementation and review; peer attestation alone does not establish exact image identity.

Protecting the server with CoCo is optional and needs separate policy and trust decisions.
